scenes.script_line: [S01] A person arriving at work in the morning, entering, preparing to begin the day.
scenes.visual_direction: A construction/ground worker arriving at the site in morning light, gearing up to start.

scenes.script_line: [S02] Entering with confident posture, greeting colleagues, beginning with positive energy.
scenes.visual_direction: A worker arriving upbeat — greeting the crew, fist bump, energy and readiness.

scenes.script_line: [S03] Split contrast: one disengaged (clock-watching, no energy) vs one deciding to make today count.
scenes.visual_direction: CONTRAST — a disengaged worker going through the motions vs an engaged worker attacking the day.

scenes.script_line: [S04] Helping a colleague, smiling with a customer, learning a new task.
scenes.visual_direction: An engaged worker helping a teammate, serving well, learning something new on site.

scenes.script_line: [S05] Noticing what needs attention and fixing it without being asked.
scenes.visual_direction: A worker spots something off — a tool, a hazard, a detail — and fixes it unprompted.

scenes.script_line: [S06] Fast sequence of small choices — arrive ready, greet properly, organize tools, clean, help.
scenes.visual_direction: Quick montage of small purposeful actions: gear ready, greeting, organizing tools, sweeping, helping.

scenes.script_line: [S07] Team in sync — one lifts another, someone steps in, solving together. We've got each other's backs.
scenes.visual_direction: A dynamic crew working in sync — helping through a hard task, gathering to solve a problem, positive atmosphere.

scenes.script_line: [S08] Tired in the morning but still preparing professionally, entering work with intention.
scenes.visual_direction: IMAGE — a tired but resolute worker at dawn, gearing up with quiet intention.

scenes.script_line: [S09] Writing one word in a notebook before the shift — 'Excellence', 'Calm', 'Service'.
scenes.visual_direction: IMAGE — close-up of a worker writing a single word in a small notebook before starting.

scenes.script_line: [S10] Team gathering at the start of a shift; collaboration, service, celebrating a result together.
scenes.visual_direction: IMAGE — a crew gathered at shift start / celebrating a completed job together.
